scope: Bounded public API observation; not exact deployed binary, public-browser or all-input proof.

complexity.timeExplanation: Visits each of R rows and C columns once, inspecting at most three neighbours per cell.
complexity.spaceExplanation: Rewrites the matrix in place with constant auxiliary space. Input conversion uses O(R * C) storage; the scalar output uses O(1). Animation snapshots are excluded.
